title: B2B Marketing - India
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in India. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI. Your work will shape how Indian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise. What you'll do Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across India's priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement. Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function. Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Indian market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team. Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns. Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works. Requirements 5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle. Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI. Deep knowledge of the Indian market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network. Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market. Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact. Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. About the role As the Global Onboarding & Enablement Operations Program Manager at ElevenLabs, you’ll help keep our global GTM onboarding and enablement programmes running smoothly as we grow. You’ll lead the day-to-day delivery of onboarding, making sure every new GTM hire gets a consistent, engaging start, while building the structure and processes that help the wider Enablement team work more effectively and scale its impact. You’ll bring structure to how we plan, deliver and measure enablement, from tracking OKRs and roadmaps to coordinating the enablement calendar, launches and certifications. You’ll also help keep the team aligned on priorities, manage cross-functional dependencies and use reporting to understand what’s working and where we can improve. Working closely with the Sales Enablement lead and partners across GTM, RevOps, Product Marketing and People, you’ll help turn priorities into well-run programmes that meet the needs of the business. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys bringing order to complex projects, delivering engaging training and finding practical, creative ways to solve problems. Own GTM onboarding: Manage onboarding cohorts end to end, from scheduling and communications to facilitating live sessions, coordinating speakers and gathering feedback. Ensure new hires across regions have a consistent, engaging experience. Develop and maintain learning content: Create training materials and e-learning modules, and keep existing content across WorkRamp and Enablement OS accurate, relevant and easy to navigate. Work with subject matter experts to turn complex topics into practical learning experiences. Coordinate certifications and enablement launches: Own the launch and certification calendar, keeping new programmes, certifications and learning initiatives moving and tracking milestones, completion and follow-up actions. Measure programme performance: Maintain dashboards and reporting on onboarding, certifications, ramp metrics and team OKRs. Use the data to highlight progress, identify gaps and help the team understand where to focus. Own Enablement operations: Run OKR and roadmap tracking, the enablement calendar, and the team’s operating rhythms (planning, check-ins and reviews). Track dependencies across RevOps, Product Marketing, People and Product, flag risks early, and keep clear ownership, timelines and follow-through on every workstream. Support major enablement events: Help plan and deliver events such as Sales Kick-Off (SKO), including session coordination, timelines and the run of show. Requirements 3-5 years experience running onboarding, training or enablement programmes in a fast-moving GTM, sales or commercial environment. Strong facilitation and presentation skills, with the confidence to lead live sessions, engage different audiences and make complex topics clear and actionable. Experience developing training materials and e-learning content that help people understand and apply new skills. Experience building and running team operations, such as OKR and roadmap tracking, and operating rhythms, with the ability to coordinate dependencies across teams and keep many stakeholders aligned.. Experience building or maintaining dashboards, trackers and reporting processes, with the ability to use data to measure progress and inform decisions. Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS), such as WorkRamp, and an understanding of how to manage learning content and track completion. A strong passion for using AI tools and agents, with hands-on experience applying them to automate repetitive tasks, improve processes and find smarter ways to work. A creative, curious approach to problem-solving, with the initiative to question existing ways of working and explore better solutions. Bonus Experience supporting a company-wide event, such as Sales Kick-Off. Experience working at a high-growth technology or AI company. Familiarity with Salesforce, Gong or other GTM reporting tools. Growth Potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Leading Enablement operations and onboarding as the team and the number of regions grow. Moving into a broader Revenue Operations, program management or enablement strategy role. Location This role is remote-first and ideally based on the East Coast of the US. The ability to operate in US Eastern (GMT-5, GMT-4) timezones is required. If you prefer, you can work from our office in New York. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.   • Has built or operated SOX controls over tax, or supported a first SOX implementation

  • CPA

Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization. Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly.   • Own customer outcomes: Be the strategic partner for a portfolio of Heidi’s customers, ensuring they achieve measurable success and realise value.

title: Senior Channel Marketing Manager, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Do:</strong></p> <p>Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.</p> <p>Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.</p> <p>Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Reports to: Senior Manager, Channel Marketing</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: Remote UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Compensation Range: £90,000 to £100,000 base plus bonus and equity</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Huntress is looking for a Senior Channel Marketing Manager to plan and execute channel marketing across EMEA, working with both distributors and resellers. You will make sure our distribution partners, and the resellers they serve, have the programs, content, and funding to generate demand for Huntress across several markets, and you will build campaigns that bring new resellers into the region's partner ecosystem.</p> <p>This role is execution-focused. The ideal candidate is organized, comfortable running many campaigns and partner relationships at once, and skilled at adapting global programs to regional needs. You are data-driven, collaborative, and passionate about helping partners succeed.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Plan and execute regional marketing programs with EMEA distributors and resellers, including demand generation campaigns, webinars, events, and product launch activity.</li> <li>Create and run campaigns to recruit new resellers in the region via distributor-led recruitment and events.</li> <li>Manage day-to-day marketing relationships with distributor partners and resellers, including joint plans, campaign calendars, and regular performance reviews.</li> <li>Enable distributors to run marketing to their reseller base, and support priority resellers directly where the impact is greatest.</li> <li>Localize and adapt global campaigns, messaging, and assets for regional markets, including language, regulatory, and market-specific needs.</li> <li>Plan the activities and campaigns that put MDF and co-marketing funds to work across distributors and resellers, partnering with the Program Manager who administers MDF, and report on the results and ROI of funded activity.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product Marketing to deliver product updates and channel-specific campaigns that drive partner activation, product adoption, and lead generation.</li> <li>Create and maintain partner-ready enablement and co-branded materials for distributors and resellers, and support engagement through the Huntress Hub partner portal.</li> <li>Track and report on regional channel marketing KPIs, including partner engagement, pipeline, campaign conversion, and fund utilization.</li> <li>Identify what distributors and resellers need to market Huntress successfully and bring those insights back to the Channel Programs team.</li> <li>Support regional partner events, distributor business reviews, and partner communications.</li> <li>Ensure consistent follow-up on all channel-generated leads, with accurate lead capture, tracking, and prompt routing to the appropriate internal owner for next steps.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You Bring To The Team:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in channel or partner marketing, ideally in the SaaS or cybersecurity space.</li> <li>Hands-on experience running co-marketing programs through distributors and resellers in EMEA.</li> <li>Experience building and running partner or reseller recruitment campaigns.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the EMEA channel landscape, including how distribution models and reseller tiers differ by country and region.</li> <li>Experience planning MDF-funded or co-marketing activities and working within channel program mechanics such as deal registration and lead sharing.</li> <li>Ability to plan, manage, and execute many campaigns and partner relationships at once across markets and time zones, and pivot quickly as needs change.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess opportunities and make ROI-based decisions on programs and investments.</li> <li>Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to lead, influence, and collaborate across organizational and geographic boundaries.</li> <li>Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, and PRM or partner portal tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).</li> <li>Willingness to travel across EMEA as needed for Partner events, QBRs, etc.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in cybersecurity, MSP, or SMB-focused markets.</li> <li>Fluency in one or more European languages in addition to English.</li> <li>Familiarity with GDPR and regional marketing compliance requirements.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like in the First Year</strong></p> <ul> <li>Joint marketing plans running with your key distributors and priority resellers.</li> <li>Regional campaigns executed on a consistent cadence with measurable pipeline title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Hiring now We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake. Role Overview This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, learning how to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Support assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and help maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings using GD&T, with review from senior engineers. Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers. Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability. Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline, completed or completing very soon. Hands-on 3D CAD skills from university projects, a placement or an internship (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered). Working knowledge of GD&T and experience producing engineering drawings, including from coursework or a team project. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics. Evidence of designing, building and testing something real, such as a placement project, Formula Student, a UAV, or a rocketry or satellite team, including troubleshooting and iteration. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. Preferred Experience A placement, internship or year in industry in aerospace, space, motorsport or another high-reliability field. Experience of several people working in one CAD assembly, for example in a Formula Student or university team, including how files and revisions were controlled. Exposure to PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM) or to formal engineering change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN). Experience of design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Satellite, CubeSat or rocketry project experience, including hardware that has launched. raw.title: Satellite Mechanical Design Engineer
raw.description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role Overview

You will design satellite structure and hardware, and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised and under control as the design matures. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, including secondary structures (panels, brackets and component mounts), thermal-control hardware, cable and harness routing, and mechanisms. Primary structure experience is welcome.

  • Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, using top-down design and skeleton models to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model.

  • Manage assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released.

  • Run interference and clash checks and maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts.

  • Produce fully dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings and interface control documents using GD&T.

  • Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers on analysis and verification planning.

  • Optimise designs for manufacturability, cost, mass and reliability, working directly with manufacturers and suppliers.

  • Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results.

  • Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform.

 

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in mechanical design of aerospace, space or other high-reliability hardware, with strong 3D CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered).

  • Practical application of GD&T and experience producing manufacturing-ready drawings.

  • Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics.

  • Demonstrated ability to design, build and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration.

  • Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team.

Preferred Experience

  • Satellite or spacecraft design, ideally detailed design of secondary structures (panel and component mounting, thermal hardware, cable and harness routing). Primary structure experience is a plus.

  • Experience working in large, multi-person CAD assemblies, including top-down design, skeleton or master models, in-context references and configurations.

  • Experience with PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM), configuration management, revision control and formal change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN).

  • Experience working within formal engineering processes, such as design reviews, documented requirements and standards.

  • Hardware that has launched.

  • Basic FEA familiarity, MGSE or ground-support equipment design, and electromechanical packaging.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

  • Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing

raw.title: Software Engineer (Data)
raw.description:
Our Mission

We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.

You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.

What you’ll be working on

  • Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.

  • Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.

  • Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.

  • Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.

  • Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.

  • Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.

  • Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Behind the scenes

Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.

Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.

We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.

  • A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.

  • Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.

  • A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration.

  • Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.

  • You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.

Nice to have, not essential:

  • Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format

  • Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.

We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.

Why join us?

Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.

At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.

You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. You'll have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, with the full offering here.

💰 Competitive base salary + equity, so you own what you build

⭐ Bonus scheme designed to reward and recognise high performance

💳 £100 monthly personal Ben Balance: for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250

🍔 Weekly lunch provided in office so you can spend quality time with the team over some tasty food!

🏖 28 days of holidays a year plus bank holidays, and an option to buy or sell 2 days per year. Your holiday entitlement increases to 30 days at your 3rd year of service!

🌴 Work-from-abroad scheme, so you can support your travels, enjoy an extended holiday, or visit loved ones.

🍼 Enhanced parental leave and workplace nursery scheme to support with the cost of childcare in a nursery setting

❤️ Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance

💌 Funded Life Assurance cover with the option to voluntarily increase. This also includes an annual health check

We are organically growing a brilliantly diverse, inclusive and respectful bunch of people we are extremely proud of. This should go without saying, but all applications are very much welcome. description: Our Solutions Architecture team understands high-level business strategy and translates it into technical requirements for our customers. We love figuring out ways to stretch the limits of what is technically possible. Our job is to provide technical leadership and guidance to customers, prospects, and partners, helping them visualise the steps to achieve their business objectives, and then delivering the outcome with them. This role spans the whole customer journey. Before the sale, you are the technical lead alongside our Sales team, shaping the solution and earning the technical win. After the sale, you stay with the customer and deliver it, owning the hands-on work that turns a signed contract into a working, adopted capability. You own the outcome, not just the design. When a customer asks a question, you answer it. As a Solutions Architect, you'll develop a deep understanding of Chainalysis' solutions and offerings, explaining complex topics to a variety of audiences in a compelling yet understandable way. You'll directly impact some of our most strategic private sector customers, and throughout all of these activities you'll provide feedback that improves the value and experience customers have with Chainalysis' solutions. In this role, you'll: Partner with the Sales team as the technical lead, running discovery, demonstrations, and proofs of value, and leading the discussions on value creation and solution development that achieve the technical win Design customer-specific solutions for the deployment and integration of Chainalysis products, and give guidance on technical challenges ranging from high-level architecture to code implementation Own the post-sale customer experience end to end, configuring, deploying, and tuning our products yourself rather than coordinating others who do it, and working alongside customer teams so they become self-sufficient Drive sustained adoption and measurable value, from fast onboarding through to the ongoing work of monitoring usage, reviewing product health, tuning rules and alerts, and intervening when adoption slips Map customer workflows to capabilities across the product suite, including investigations, compliance, security, and data analysis solutions Investigate using Chainalysis tooling to a competent standard, tracing, attributing, and analysing on the platform, so you can surface actionable insights and integrate Chainalysis into the customer's compliance and risk workflows Be the person customers look to for answers, resolving technical, compliance, analytical, and operational questions directly, and owning time-sensitive decisions by validating signals quickly and moving the right matters through the correct escalation path Communicate and translate complex technical requirements to our Product and Engineering teams, including data gaps such as unclustered or unattributed services that you find in the field Become a trusted technical advisor to both internal and external customers, identifying business opportunities and substantially increasing our foothold with private sector customers and prospects We're looking for candidates who have: Worked in or directly with our private sector customer types: banks, cryptocurrency exchanges, payment processors, and blockchain developers Practical understanding of compliance, investigative, and risk workflows, and can speak credibly from practitioner experience in investigations, compliance, fraud, risk, or security A technical generalist background, comfortable with REST API integrations and familiar with how data is structured in SQL, and always interested in learning more Experience of account or customer management for an enterprise SaaS business, including commercial awareness and partnering with sales counterparts on renewals and expansion The ability to communicate clearly with both technical and executive audiences Curiosity, fast learning, and motivation to solve difficult customer problems A collaborative approach and generosity with knowledge Fluency in English Nice to have experience: Financial compliance and anti-money laundering obligations Proficiency in Python, REST API integrations, and SQL databases Hands-on use of AI tooling to improve delivery quality or speed Experience handling sensitive data and proprietary methods, and protecting them while using them effectively AI at Chainalysis AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it. AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch. Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it. title: Pentester Senior / Red Team
description: Ballpoint, c'est 7 consultants à Paris répartis en deux équipes : une équipe attaque pentest / Red Team, et une équipe défense avec le développement de Trapster. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI. Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence. Ce qui compte aujourd'hui, c'est de comprendre l'entreprise qu'on attaque : son métier, ses actifs critiques, ce qui la mettrait vraiment à genoux. C'est pour ça que le Red Team est au cœur de ce qu'on fait : un attaquant réaliste, avec de vrais objectifs, face à une organisation et ses vrais enjeux. Notre raison d'être : faire progresser durablement le niveau de sécurité de nos clients, pas seulement leur lister des failles. Nous cherchons donc notre Responsable Pentest / Red Team : la personne qui construira notre pôle Red Team et fera grandir l'équipe. Nos valeurs Chez Ballpoint, on accompagne nos clients dans la durée : Red Team, pentest continu, retests. Nos consultants connaissent leur SI autant que leurs enjeux métier, et c’est ce qui guide notre façon de travailler. 1. Curiosité : l'art de creuser au-delà des outils Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents. 2. Chacun fait la différence Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse. Le poste Tu prends la responsabilité technique de toutes nos missions offensives, en restant sur le terrain. Rattaché directement au fondateur, tu travailles avec l'équipe pentest / Red Team. Porter la qualité des missions : cadrage technique, méthodologie, relecture et validation des rapports avant livraison. Mener les opérations Red Team de bout en bout : scénario, infrastructure d'attaque, évasion, débrief au COMEX. Rester un pentester actif : web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel, sur une partie significative de ton temps. Faire grandir l'équipe : montée en compétence des juniors, parcours de certification, partage des techniques. Faire évoluer nos offres et nos outils : pentest continu, templates de rapport, outillage interne, veille. Appuyer l'avant-vente : calls techniques avec les prospects et chiffrage des périmètres. Ton profil Tu as au moins 5 ans de pentest derrière toi, dont de vraies opérations Red Team, et l'envie de faire progresser une équipe. Indispensable Solide expérience en compromission Active Directory et en pentest web. Opérations Red Team menées en conditions réelles : C2, contournement d'EDR, ingénierie sociale. Un français écrit impeccable. La capacité à expliquer une chaîne d'attaque à un RSSI comme à un directeur général. Modalités de télétravail flexibles mais présence à Paris nécessaire. Un bon feeling avec l'équipe : on passe beaucoup de temps ensemble, en mission comme au bureau, et l'ambiance compte autant que le niveau technique. Un plus Certifications offensives (OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, OSWE ou équivalent). Expérience d'un cadre PASSI ou d'environnements sensibles. CVE, articles, talks, outils open source. Avantages Tu rejoins une équipe de 7 consultants où tes choix techniques deviennent la norme, avec un accès direct au fondateur et une mission claire : faire évoluer notre pôle Red Team. Les missions sont variées (web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel…), et comme on suit nos clients dans la durée, tu vois l'impact réel de ton travail d'une année sur l'autre. Ballpoint évolue vite, et tu en es un acteur direct. Tes idées ont un effet visible dès la semaine suivante, pas après six mois de comités. Temps de R&D : du temps dédié à tes outils, à la recherche de vulnérabilités ou à la préparation d'un talk. Formations et certifications : un budget annuel (OSEP, CRTO, OSWE…), passées sur ton temps de travail. Télétravail : possible, avec 2 à 3 jours par semaine dans nos bureaux à Paris. Les classiques : CDI cadre, mutuelle, prévoyance, transport, tickets restaurant. Le process C'est le fondateur qui gère ce recrutement de bout en bout. Pas de cabinet, pas de tri automatique : chaque candidature est lue et étudiée avec attention. Ça peut prendre un peu de temps, alors n'hésite pas à relancer. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ce05398d7259c8f0" class="markdown markdown-main-panel enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ce05398d7259c8f0" class="markdown markdown-main-panel enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color"> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="0">Notre Team Data lake recherche un·e Senior Product Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris</strong></p> <p>Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : au travers du sport rendre le bien être accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client.</p> <p>Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons notre futur.e Senior Product Manager pour rejoindre les équipes Data Factory.</p> <p>Cette plateforme technologique, globale à tout le groupe de manière internationale, soutient le développement de l’usage de la Data et de l’IA chez Decathlon, du calcul du chiffre d’affaires à l’aide de conception de produits innovants.</p> <p>Nous sommes garants des outils, de la scalabilité, de la mise en place et du respect des bonnes pratiques de développement. Nous accompagnons au quotidien l’ensemble des acteurs métiers tels que Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists.</p> <p>La Data Factory est conçue comme une&nbsp;<em>Modern Data Stack</em>, avec un lakehouse comme centre de gravité.</p> <p>Elle est ensuite divisée en plusieurs équipes, chacune étant pilotée par un leader technique, avec comme ambition de travailler avec un.e Product Manager attitré.e.</p> <p>Notre équipe&nbsp;<strong>Data Lake</strong> est donc la brique fondamentale de cette mission.</p> <p>Notre mission ? Mettre à disposition des solutions de stockage pour l’ensemble de la Data Platform de Decathlon, tout en garantissant la gouvernance, robustesse et scalabilité par défaut. Véritable pilier de la gouvernance technique du patrimoine de données, notre équipe gère les métadonnées via le metastore Unity Catalog et les data contracts, permettant ainsi de construire une observabilité globale de la plateforme (usage, lignage, etc.). Un terrain de jeu technique à fort impact et aux défis d'envergure internationale !</p> <p>L'équipe est composée actuellement de :</p> <ul> <li>1 Product Manager</li> <li>1 Data Architect</li> <li>1 Data Engineer</li> <li>1 Software Engineer</li> <li>2 Ops Engineer</li> </ul> <p>Exemples de&nbsp;<strong>challenges actuels</strong> :</p> <ul> <li>Améliorer notre offre de support pour faciliter le parcours utilisateur (documentation, gestion des incidents, ...)</li> <li>Discussion avec les équipes Data/IA des pays et domaines sur leurs challenges du moment (données sensibles, données privées, ...) pour définir les priorités de nos équipes</li> <li>Comment faciliter la gouvernance des données ? description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL)</span></span><span data-contrast="none"> is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest </span><span data-contrast="none">health threats. </span><span data-contrast="none">Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care. &nbsp;</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p>The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services &amp; Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.</p> <p>Reporting to the Director, Maternal &amp; Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Work Location: </strong>100% Remote with travel as stated. Eligible for candidates based in the US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Rwanda, India, France and DRC.</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <h4><strong>Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.</li> <li>Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.</li> <li>Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.</li> <li>Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.</li> <li>Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Change Management and Institutional Strengthening</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead the development and adaptation of change management and implementation approaches to enable government and health facility teams to introduce, adapt and sustain improvements in service delivery.</li> <li>Provide strategic accompaniment and coaching to strengthen government leadership, management and institutional capabilities, including decision-making processes, performance management, accountability mechanisms and continuous improvement practices.</li> <li>Design and guide practical implementation approaches, including change management plans, improvement processes, team-based coaching and mechanisms to address barriers to implementation.</li> <li>Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Country Implementation and Technical Support</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.</li> <li>Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.</li> <li>Provide technical leadership on country assessments, programme design and implementation planning, ensuring interventions respond to demonstrated system bottlenecks and country priorities.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Learning, Evidence and Innovation</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Guide the application of data, implementation learning, and performance measurement to assess the effectiveness of service delivery changes, identify emerging challenges, and inform course correction.</li> <li>Document and synthesise implementation experience, developing practical tools, approaches and lessons that can be adapted and applied across countries and other priority health areas.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Education</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Clinical qualification in medicine, nursing, midwifery or a related health profession, with experience in clinical service delivery. An advanced degree in public health, health systems, health management or a related field is desirable.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>At least 10 years of relevant experience in clinical service delivery, health systems strengthening and service delivery transformation, including substantial experience in low- and middle-income countries.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working with government institutions and health service managers to strengthen institutional capabilities, embed new ways of working and sustain improvements beyond individual projects.</li> <li>Experience using routine performance data, quality improvement methods, and implementation learning to inform technical decisions, assess results, and adapt interventions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills &amp; Abilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Expertise in applying systems thinking, change management and health systems transformation approaches to diagnose complex service delivery challenges, design practical solutions, and achieve measurable improvements.</li> <li>Proven track record of leading or supporting the implementation of complex health service delivery reforms, including changes to clinical pathways, care models, management practices or health system processes.</li> <li>Deep, nuanced understanding of clinical quality and patient safety, including the organisational, workforce and system factors that influence the reliability and effectiveness of frontline health services.</li> <li>Strong technical leadership, facilitation, coaching, problem-solving, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate resistance to change and work effectively across clinical, technical and management teams.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex health systems challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and to influence diverse technical, clinical, government and management stakeholders.</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care. &nbsp;</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p>The Director, Maternal &amp; Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.</p> <p>The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Work Location: </strong>100% Remote with travel as stated.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <h4><strong>Strategic</strong> <strong>Leadership</strong> <strong>and Portfolio Management</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.</li> <li>Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.</li> <li>Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Technical Leadership and Program Development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.</li> <li>Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.</li> <li>Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.</li> <li>Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead senior-level engagement with technical and policy discussions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Performance, Learning and Accountability</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, approaches.</li> <li>Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Education</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.</li> <li>Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills &amp; Abilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of countries and organizational functions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.</li> <li>Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.</li> <li>Fluency in English fonio.ai is a market leader in AI agents for SMBs. We started with phone agents and now also cover WhatsApp, web chat, email and a full AI phone system. We’re growing fast across Europe, the UK, the US and Brazil.

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months, then went from $10M to $20M in about 8 weeks. Today we serve 10,000+ customers.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.
Join one of the fastest-growing companies! 🚀

The role

You'll own Content Marketing for the French-speaking market and shape how thousands of businesses discover, understand and trust fonio.

From performance ads and landing pages to organic content and product messaging, you'll help define our voice across every stage of the customer journey.

What you'll do

  • Own website and landing page copy for the French-speaking market

  • Write high-performing copy for Meta, Google, LinkedIn and other paid channels

  • Script ad creatives for YouTube and Paid Social

  • Create and execute organic content strategies across social platforms

  • Collaborate with creators, customers and influencers to produce authentic content

  • Improve messaging through user research, A/B testing and performance insights

What you bring

  • 4+ years of experience in Content Marketing, Copywriting or Growth Marketing

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or another fast-growing software environment

  • Outstanding writing skills in French

What we offer

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.
Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet 🚀

title: Pullup Entertainment - Cdi - Responsable Comptable Generale (H/F/Nb)
description: Chez PulluP Entertainment, nous avons pour but d’offrir aux joueurs du monde entier des expériences uniques. Notre ligne éditoriale se démarque grâce à des concepts innovants, des gameplays alternatifs et des univers originaux qui transcendent les frontières du jeu vidéo. Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience et de succès, nous mettons notre passion et notre créativité au service du jeu et d’histoires inoubliables. Pour le plaisir de tous . Véritable bras droit du Directeur comptable, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec lui sur tout le périmètre, maison mère comme filiales. Vous aurez la responsabilité de deux comptables généraux ayant chacun un périmètre défini et un comptable client.  Vos principales missions seront : 1- Gestion quotidienne de la tenue de la comptabilité et le bon suivi des obligations : Supervision de la comptabilité clients (suivi des comptes clients et des relances) et générale (provisions, paie, fiscalités, etc.) Echanges continus et réguliers avec la comptabilité fournisseur Assurer le bon suivi de l’établissement des déclarations fiscales et des comptes annuels Assurer le bon suivi du juridique annuel Assurer la gestion des déclarations fiscales de l'entreprise (TVA, IS et autres obligations fiscales). 2- Etablissement des clôtures périodiques (dont la semestrielle et l’annuelle sont publiées) :  Pour les sociétés dont la tenue comptable est internalisée : établissement de clôture complète en collaboration avec les équipes comptables internes Pour les sociétés françaises dont la tenue est externalisée et les sociétés étrangères : assurer le suivi, la communication et la revue des remontées des informations avec la comptable générale en charge Etablissement et suivi des calendriers de clôtures en collaboration avec le contrôle de gestion Veiller au respect des exigences réglementaires et fiscales 3- Audit et Comptes consolidés : Vous serez le.a garant.e de la bonne réciprocité des comptes inter-compagnies  Vous serez l’interlocuteur.trice principal.e auprès de la société qui effectue les comptes consolidés du Groupe.  Point de contact pour les auditeurs autant sur les comptes sociaux que sur les comptes consolidés  Vous aurez un rôle essentiel dans l’établissement des rapports financiers semestriels et annuels qui sont publiés 4- Management : Vous encadrerez une équipe de trois personnes en définissant les priorités et les objectifs de l’équipe en accord vos managers Vous participerez à la montée en compétence des collaborateurs et à la définition de leur plan de formation Vous serez un soutien de l’équipe pour les tâches quotidiennes   5- Projets Transverses Mise en place de process généralisés et homogénéisés des filiales dont la tenue est internalisée en collaboration avec la Direction financière Déploiement et optimisation des process d'automatisation comptable Participer aux projets d'amélioration des processus et des systèmes financiers   Ce que l'on attend de vous :  Véritable référent(e) comptable, vous êtes capable de garantir la fiabilité des comptes tout en accompagnant les évolutions d'une organisation en croissance. Diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en Comptabilité, Finance ou Audit (DSCG, Master CCA ou équivalent), vous disposez d'une solide expertise technique. Vous justifiez d 'au moins 5 années d'expérience en cabinet d'audit ou d'expertise comptable OU d'au moins 7 années d'expérience en comptabilité générale au sein d'un environnement international. Vous avez déjà accompagné des projets structurants (croissance externe, intégration de sociétés, évolution des processus ou des outils financiers) et en maîtrisez les impacts comptables, fiscaux et organisationnels. Vous possédez une expérience réussie en management et savez fédérer, développer et faire monter en compétence vos équipes. Vous maîtrisez les normes comptables françaises (French GAAP), ainsi que les réglementations fiscales et sociales françaises. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel, et appréciez l'amélioration continue des processus. Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement international et êtes capable d'échanger quotidiennement en anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Une connaissance de SAP ByDesign constitue un atout apprécié. Ce que l'on dit de vous : Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) capable d'accompagner le business avec pragmatisme et leadership. Vous combinez autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités. Vous savez prendre du recul, prioriser et structurer votre activité dans un environnement en constante évolution. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à embarquer les équipes et à créer des relations de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs. Pédagogue, vous savez rendre accessibles des sujets comptables, fiscaux ou juridiques complexes auprès d'équipes non spécialistes. title: Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution - Manager
description: Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises. Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions. En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International". L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution est spécialisée en évaluation de préjudice et accompagnement sur le volet financier de précontentieux et contentieux en tant qu’expert de partie dans le cadre de procédures amiables, judiciaires, ou arbitrales, mais également en tant que tiers expert. L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution de Eight Advisory, acteur reconnu sur son marché et en fort développement, recherche un futur manager. En tant que consultant manager, vous aurez l’opportunité d’intervenir sur des dossiers pluridisciplinaires afin de développer vos expertises et des compétences transverses sur nos métiers du conseil. Au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine, en forte croissance, vous interviendrez sur des missions d’ : · Evaluation de préjudice et de support aux contentieux à forts enjeux pour nos clients (rupture de relations contractuelles, sinistres industriels, litiges post-acquisition, clauses d’ajustement de prix, responsabilité contractuelle, actions en concurrence déloyale et en contrefaçon, etc.). · Expertise financière dans le cadre de revue de grands projets industriels (analyse de l’origine de dérapage et appréciation des risques associés) et d’accompagnement de sociétés dans le cadre de leur changement stratégique (préparation de business plan, aide à la décision dans le cadre de changement structurel). · Investigation financière liée à des problématiques de détournement d’actifs, de manipulation d’états financiers, d’infraction réglementaire etc. · Analyses de gestion en lien avec une mise en responsabilité du dirigeant en cas de défaillance d’entreprise (analyse de l’origine des difficultés, analyse des flux comptables et financiers, détermination de la date de cessation des paiements, etc.). · Ingénierie financière liée à des enjeux haut de bilan et des enjeux opérationnels. Au quotidien, sous la direction des associés du département, vous serez responsable des travaux suivants : · Conception et réalisation des analyses financières et comptables, · Rédaction des projets de livrable, · Animation de la relation avec les différents intervenants présents sur les missions (clients et avocats), · Encadrement et formation d’une équipe de seniors et d'analystes, · Gestion des aspects administratifs des dossiers (organisation de la mission, facturation, suivi des heures). Vos travaux seront adaptés aux besoins de nos clients et auront pour objectif de créer de la valeur dans des situations complexes de précontentieux ou de contentieux. Vous aurez l’occasion : · De bénéficier d’une diversité d’approches (problématiques financières, juridiques, stratégiques et opérationnelles) ; · D’être exposé aux clients et aux avocats, et notamment de participer aux réunions de présentation de nos analyses et d’échanges avec les opérationnels ; · De faire un travail à haute valeur ajoutée pour nos clients. Vous participerez également à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités et au développement de notre activité (organisation d’évènements, rédaction d’article etc.), et aurez l’opportunité de vous investir sur des projets transverses au sein du cabinet (formation, recrutement, RSE, parrainage des juniors etc.). Diplômé(e) d’une grande école de commerce ou d'un Master CCA, vous justifiez d’une expérience de 5 à 7 ans en cabinet d’audit et vous vous êtes spécialisé(e) en évaluation de préjudice financier. Vous êtes doté (e) de solides bases comptables, de qualités analytiques et rédactionnelles avérées, vous maitrisez l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit et idéalement l’espagnol. Curieux(se), persévérant(e), polyvalent(e), disponible et ambitieux(se), vous savez encadrer des équipes, prendre des initiatives et avez le sens du service client. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
